title: Spellcrux Amulet
summary: Restore an expended spell slot as a Bonus Action once per Long Rest.

fields.Spell Slot Restoration: Bonus Action on yourself once per Long Rest. Choose a level from 1 to 6 and restore an expended slot of that level. Regular and Warlock slots of the same chosen level can both restore, as can Gale’s special level 3 slot alongside a normal slot. Gear-granted and created slots can restore. A level with no expended slot provides no restoration.
fields.Recharge: The restored slot survives unequipping, but the cooldown stays with the amulet.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
